title: SoK: Reconstruction Attacks on Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: An artifact for a PoPETs 2027 submission benchmarking 13 reconstruction/attribute-inference attacks against 9 synthetic-data-generation methods across 5 datasets, built on the NIST CRC red-teaming methodology. Its sdg module uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer to produce two of the benchmarked synthetic datasets and calls sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality to score fidelity.
